text:
alex: Quick sync — we hit a hard cap on Standard_ND40rs_v2 quota in eastus2 under subscription 9a8b7c6d-0f12-4e34-b9c0-abcde1234567. Need quota increase + capacity reservation for prod tenant.

 tess: Which region/quantity are we requesting? any preferred dates for reservation?

 alex: Need 8 x ND40rs (preferred) + fallback 12 x NC24s if ND delayed. Target date: week of 2026-06-08. Also need increased ephemeral port ranges on the subnet and /27 -> /26 for the compute subnet.

 ryan: Filing support ticket now. Raising to expedited business-critical. Support ticket: 2100-55872. Adding subscription owner tags and escalation notes.

 azure-tam: Thanks — I've kicked off the quota increase request and looped in capacity reservations team. They asked for estimated start/end dates and sustained vCPU consumption. Can you paste the output of current usage?

 alex: Pasted quick check:
```
az vm list-usage --location eastus2 --output table
Name                               CurrentValue  Limit
Standard_ND40rs_v2                  0             8
Standard_NC24s_v3                   4             12
```
We currently have 4 NC24s in staging, need 8 ND40rs in prod.

 maria: Finance confirmed one-time reservation budget up to $48k for the month; billing approved. Filing PO now.

 billing-bot: Reservation charge approved; internal reference PO-2026-1147.

 ryan: Update from support: they've created a capacity reservation request CR-2026-54321 and asked for an ARM template of the VM sku list. I pushed a small template in the ticket.

 tess: I've created infra ticket INF-327 in Linear and added owners + checklist (subnet sizing, NSG rules, AKS nodepool config). Link: https://linear.app/redwood/issue/INF-327

 infra-oncall: Heads-up — if ND40rs provisioning slips, we should stage an A/B failover using NC24 nodepools with GPU-aware scheduling. I'll add a runbook step.

 alex: Also raised a networking support case for ephemeral port limits and service endpoints (network ticket 31002). Azure asked for expected concurrent TCP connections per host.

 maria: For the expected connections: 3500 ephemeral sockets per host (peak). Also need VNet peering to analytics VNet approved.

 azure-tam: Received. TAM escalated to capacity ops. ETA for quota increase 48-72h, capacity reservation depends on regional avail — will update in ticket 2100-55872 and CR-2026-54321.

 tess: Please add me as support contact on the Azure ticket (tess@redwood.com). I'll own the follow-up and verify NSG port openings.

 ryan: Noted. I'll attach the ARM template and the provisioning checklist. If we don't hear back by EOD tomorrow I'll escalate to TAM lead.

 alex: Thanks all — ping me here once reservation CR moves to 'confirmed' so we can kick off terraform apply in prod. :thumbsup:

 maria: Adding final: don't forget to request quota increases in the backup region (westeurope) as contingency.

 alex: Good call — opened a parallel ticket for westeurope: 2100-55873.

 tess: Closing loop for now. Will post updates and ETA in this thread.
